## Change and mathematical scope

PR958's quadratic five-port obstruction prices coordinate-star totals separately and leaves coded combinations outside its theorem. This research note resolves the smallest cube, p=k=5, for arbitrary finite, including overcomplete, GF(2) affine-code factorizations of the full star decoder matrix. Its exact pairing-rank sum is at least 32, and its exact minimum peak is eight. A literal four-total decoder attains both, with ranks 8+8+8+8; a two-parity-total decoder has ranks 16+16. The ten original star observations have rank six, but the decoder matrix has rank two.

Under the explicitly inherited additive stage ledger, c>=32=v leaves D<=(s-1)32-s32=-32 for every s>=3, even granting all other work zero cost. No larger-p ceiling, physical COPY realization, supplier, new kappa or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Gather, frames, restoration, precision, hosting and all-size/analytic obligations remain open. Only `research/five-cube-coded-copy-seed42/` is added; selected frontier and upstream are unchanged.

Exact base: `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`. OS assignment seed 42, structural decoder track. Six predecessor/context snapshots are retained verbatim with SHA256/Git-blob pins. Credit Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson), PR958 (head `28d68c88f0184835d8c8a7266ab8d0dad3f18a8a`); Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled, PR231; icekylinx/eumemic; DreamingOfClouds, PR446/595; Jacob Sussman and Zhihao Chen's frame/common-label lineage. PR669's different odd-diagonal model is credited as related work. Prepared for @martinxxx9 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI implementation and final proof review. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

## Validation

Python 3.10+, standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python -I -O -B research/five-cube-coded-copy-seed42/verify.py
python -I -O -B research/five-cube-coded-copy-seed42/independent.py --exhaustive-factorizations
python -I -O -B research/five-cube-coded-copy-seed42/test_package.py
```

All pass on Windows/CPython 3.12.14. The modular census and separately written exact-integer elimination agree on all 3,969 support-pair ranks. Both complete 1,024-entry decoder witnesses pass, with eight primary and nine independent controls. The optional reduced-space experiment exhausts 1,324,327 source assignments (1,226,104 all-nonzero); its scoped minima are not promoted to unrestricted fixed-length optima. The general floor instead follows from the finite census, Sylvester's rank inequality and an independent diagonal-coverage argument.

Six package checks cover altered source bytes, omission, primary/independent receipt corruption, isolated optimized relocation and preservation of existing output files. Exact regeneration reproduces the primary receipt byte for byte. The PR958 predecessor checker, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace check pass. A final overlap refresh through PR1045 found no duplicate and main remained at the base. Full repository/selected supplier cold replay, Linux CI and proof-assistant verification were not run for this isolated research contribution. Detailed proof, receipts and limitations are in README.md, PROOF.md and VALIDATION.md.
